# Morning memo - 2026-08-14

**Source failures:** `github-trending-weekly` still has no fetcher configured. `reddit-localllama` returned HTTP 429 during fetch.

## Worth attention

- **Gemini 3.7 Flash** — https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-3-7-flash/
  Google says 3.7 Flash is its new workhorse for coding and agents, with better debugging, web-app generation, and tool-heavy workflow performance than 3.6 Flash. The practical part is the price: intro pricing is half the prior 3.6 Flash rate through December 31, 2026. If you are comparing fast coding models for agent runs, this one moves onto the shortlist immediately, but treat the benchmark claims as vendor-reported until you test it yourself.

- **ZOOMSDAY: Zoom zero-click RCE via annotation** — https://a.security/blog/asecurity-zoomsday
  A Security published a detailed write-up of zero-click annotation bugs that let a meeting participant execute code on other native Zoom clients, with CVEs and fixed-version guidance. The operational takeaway is simple: patch Zoom clients fast, and if you still have older clients around, avoid E2EE meetings because Zoom's server-side filtering cannot inspect encrypted traffic. This is a real patch-urgency item, not theory.

- **DeepSeek Harness developer preview** — https://deepseek.com/harness/en/
  DeepSeek announced a Harness preview for coding-agent workflows, which could matter if it becomes a credible runtime or integration layer. But the primary page crashed in the approved browser during review, so evidence is incomplete and this is not ready for recommendation. Keep it on watch until docs stabilize and someone demonstrates real workflow leverage.
